blocks.text: The US dollar has softened modestly against major peers as interest-rate differentials narrow. Moves have been orderly, with little sign of stress in funding markets.
Crude prices have been volatile in a range. Producers' supply discipline is offset by softer demand indicators from manufacturing surveys. Gold continues to attract steady buying as a diversifier.

items: Commodity currencies track oil and metals more closely than rate spreads this month.
Agricultural prices remain subdued after strong harvests.
Industrial metals respond to infrastructure and grid-investment headlines.

blocks.text: A calmer dollar eases financial conditions for emerging markets and for companies with large overseas revenues, while commodity volatility keeps inflation forecasts uncertain.
